COLONY PLANNER S4b PART 2, ROUND 2: ONE CODEX REVIEW FINDING ON PR #970. Work on this branch only (feat/plan-s4b2-raven-import, head 207fdba9). Fix only this, with regression tests.

FINDING (verified by the reviewer). In apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/raven-apply.ts, matchBelt (around line 68) compares the Raven body name to the belt location name case-sensitively (`name !== location.name` and clusterNumber(name, location.name)). matchRavenBodies matches names case-insensitively and trimmed. So "AMBER LANTERN A BELT CLUSTER 2" (catalogue "Amber Lantern A Belt Cluster 2", where Cluster 1 represents the belt) misses the belt branch, then matches the hidden cluster body case-insensitively, and visibleRef makes its sites Unplaced and drops its slot counts; the same name in catalogue casing imports correctly.

FIX. Normalise names the same way matchRavenBodies does (trim, case-insensitive; reuse its normaliser if one exists rather than writing a second) before the belt-name equality test and before clusterNumber's prefix/suffix test, so the belt branch catches every name the body matcher would. Keep cluster-number parsing exact (digits only) and keep the existing ambiguity handling. Add tests: an all-caps and a mixed-case "<belt> Cluster N" for a non-representative cluster map to the belt's location with belt_cluster_moved and keep their slot counts; an all-caps belt name itself maps to the belt; leading/trailing spaces too.

VALIDATION: apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, ESLint/Prettier on touched files; then `python -m pytest -q tests/ --ignore=tests/integration --ignore=tests/test_v3_spatial_pyramid.py --ignore=tests/test_admin_cache_truthfulness.py --ignore=tests/test_journal_commander_association.py` with no failures. Report results and every changed line.
